name: Biomedical Table Recognition Benchmark (Neurological Disorders)
description: An evaluation dataset and benchmark measuring table recognition performance on biomedical literature related to neurological disorders.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used by researchers working on biomedical document understanding and table extraction; limited broad community adoption.
notes: Domain-specific dataset with potentially limited size; designed for non-LLM vision/IE methods (risk of overlap with general web-trained models unknown); evaluation typically sensitive to schema/annotation choices.
